_about: Dated claims in the guides that go stale. One row per claim: page slug, the claim as the page states it, the source to re-check, and the date to re-check by (YYYY-MM-DD). .github/workflows/freshness.yml opens one GitHub issue listing every row past its date (1st of each month, or run by hand). After re-checking: update the page (sources, then assemble.py + check-all.sh), then move review_by forward or delete the row.
